whenToUse: Enrolling an authenticator app: scan a QR code or type the setup key, verify a code, save backup codes.
The first-time two-factor setup step inside account security settings.
avoidWhen: Entering a code at sign-in for an already-enrolled account — use otp-01.
Managing all security factors and devices in one place — use settings-07.
a11y: Each step region is labelled with aria-labelledby and the setup-key reveal uses aria-expanded with aria-controls.
Decorative icons are aria-hidden; keep the setup key selectable for users who cannot scan.
